children: Shares of Aegis Logistics Ltd. will be in focus on Thursday, November 12, after the company launched a qualified institutional placement (QIP) to raise up to ₹3,500 crore, with the base issue size pegged at ₹3,000 crore.

The company has indicated an issue price of ₹1,210 per equity share. This represents a discount of approximately 1.4% to Aegis Logistics' closing price of ₹1,225.10 on the NSE on Wednesday, November 11, 2026.
At the base issue size, the proposed QIP is expected to result in an equity dilution of approximately 7.1% of the company's pre-issue outstanding share capital, based on the indicative issue price.
The company plans to deploy the proceeds from the proposed fundraising towards strengthening its financial position and supporting business operations.
The primary objectives of the fundraise include:
: Repayment of the company's outstanding borrowings, either fully or partially, to improve its debt profile and potentially reduce interest costs.
: Funding additional working capital needs to support the company's operational requirements and business activities.
The proposed capital raise is aimed at providing Aegis Logistics with greater financial flexibility to manage its debt obligations while meeting its incremental working capital requirements.
Meanwhile, Aegis Logistics shares ended 0.13% lower at ₹1,225.10 on Wednesday. Despite the marginal decline in the latest session, the stock has rallied more than 70% so far in 2026.

title: Aegis Logistics announces ₹3,500 crore fundraising plan through QIP; stock in focus
